businesses.business: specialty contracting for telecommunications and utility infrastructure

offering_description.value: Provides engineering, construction, maintenance and installation services for telecommunications providers, including fiber-optic and wireless networks, and for electric and gas utilities. Customers are large telecom carriers, cable operators and utilities. Work is performed by employees and subcontractors in the field.

primary_services.value: fiber network construction; wireless infrastructure services; engineering and design; underground utility locating; electric and gas utility construction and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: telecommunications carriers, cable operators, wireless providers, electric and gas utilities, fiber builders

end_markets.value: telecommunications; broadband; wireless; electric and gas utilities

revenue_model.value: project or contract: multi-year master service agreements and project-based construction work; service fees: maintenance, installation and locating services, often unit-priced or time-and-materials

value_chain_position.value: service provider: contractor performing engineering, construction and maintenance of network infrastructure for telecom and utility customers

geography_served.value: US national: United States across many states

specialization.value: related lines: telecom construction, underground locating, engineering and utility infrastructure services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with telecom carriers and utilities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: worker safety (OSHA), contractor licensing, environmental and right-of-way rules, one-call damage prevention laws
